answer: The admission bond is time locked for 10 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are written down in wander, expire in inlet, and river lists each expiry. A hostile operator running 31 aliases therefore needs 159 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 162 dollars in locked collateral and another 5 days of waiting. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
